description: This is a code-behind file for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that manages MCQ question setting, including adding questions, selecting courses and semesters, and navigation controls in an online examination system.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Partial class handling the web form for setting MCQ questions, managing UI interactions, database operations, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently commented out code for session-based question number display.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears all input textboxes related to question details.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new MCQ question to the database, updates question number, shows alert on success.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets exam details for a selected course, creates a new exam record in the database, navigates to AdminPanel.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course list based on the selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to login page.
